taps.question: How clear are you on what is expected of you this week?
How much support did you get from your manager this week?
How connected are you with your team this week?
How well has your training prepared you for your work this week?
How manageable is your workload this week?

conversation.text: You tapped "Little support". What is happening?

My team lead is on calls with Europe all day, so when I get stuck on a billing dispute my Teams message waits until the next morning. Yesterday a customer credit note ended up waiting two days for review.
What would help you get credit notes reviewed faster when your team lead is busy?
A fixed 15-minute slot each day with my lead or having a backup person to ask would really help.

Here is what I will tell HR: The employee experiences delayed responses from their team lead when stuck on billing disputes, leading to multi-day review delays for customer credit notes. [MANAGER_SUPPORT] "My team lead is on calls with Europe all day, so when I get stuck on a billing dispute my Teams message waits until the next morning."
